changes.title: Slow frame log
items: Slow-frame logs include loading state and measured update/drawing sections, grouped into short summaries during a bad stretch.

changes.title: Lazy update notes
items: Settings has a What's new tab. It loads a few recent versions when opened, with Load more for older notes.

changes.title: Direct play
items: Games that skip dressing up start playing when ready, without a start card. Update notes no longer load at startup.

changes.title: Compressed logs
items: Saved playtest comments and JSON logs use lossless input runs and compression when available. Builders can still restore older JSON logs, and oversized or damaged files report an error.

changes.title: Attack system
items: Animal attacks can hit a witch and a creature together without skipping either.
A calm legend's circle also protects you from outside attacks that stun, slow or pull you.

changes.title: Art cache followups
items: Saved pictures can load before the drawing tools.
Party animals in matching outfits share saved pictures, drawn for their current age.
